# Blitter register trace corpus -- proposal §12's "recorded Workbench
# traces" half of the blitter differential (docs/blitter-differential.md).
# One line per distinct register signature, already deduplicated by
# `crate::blitter_trace::BlitterTrace` at capture time.
#
# Provenance: `machine-hosted --rom nondistribution/A1200.47.115.rom --hd
# nondistribution/m68k-machine.hdf --blitter-trace <this file> --screenshot
# ... --screenshot-frame 4000 --max-frames 4500` -- the same planar
# Workbench boot this project's baselines are pinned against (752x576, 6
# distinct colours, 13507/433152 non-background pixels at frame 4000,
# unchanged by tracing). Neither the ROM nor the HDF is redistributable
# (nondistribution/README.md), so this file -- derived data, not the
# image itself -- is what's checked in; regenerate by rerunning the above
# with those local, unredistributed inputs.
#
# Over that boot: 110 area-mode `BLTSIZE` arms observed, deduplicating to
# the 30 lines below; 1368 line-mode arms were seen and skipped (line mode
# is out of scope for this recorder -- see blitter_trace.rs's module doc
# comment for why). Every one of the 30 shares one shape: `USED` only
# (`BLTCON0` bits 8-11 = 0001, i.e. no memory-backed source channel) with
# minterm `LF=0xF0` (`D = A`, so a disabled A channel's constant `BLTADAT`
# becomes the fill value) -- graphics.library's plain rectangle-fill
# idiom, used repeatedly for window/icon background clears. They vary
# only in `BLTAMOD`/`BLTCMOD`/`BLTDMOD`, `BLTADAT`/`BLTBDAT`, and
# width/height. Nothing here uses a shifted barrel, a non-identity
# minterm, `BLTCON1`'s fill mode, or more than one active channel --
# narrower than the randomised half's coverage (256 minterms, all 16
# channel-enable combinations, full 0-15 shifts), which is itself a real
# finding: see docs/blitter-differential.md.
#
# columns: bltcon0 bltcon1 bltafwm bltalwm amod bmod cmod dmod adat bdat cdat width height c_eq_d
# (all decimal; amod/bmod/cmod/dmod signed, width/height are BLTSIZE's raw
# fields with 0 meaning 64/1024, c_eq_d is 0 or 1 -- see
# crates/machine-hosted/src/blitter_trace.rs and docs/blitter-differential.md)
